name: Shopify app
h1: Privacy policy for Shopify app developers
metaTitle: Shopify App Privacy Policy — Mandatory Compliance Webhooks | PrivacyPage
metaDescription: For Shopify app developers, not stores: Shopify requires mandatory compliance webhooks for data requests and deletion. Your privacy policy should match how your app handles them.
answer: Shopify apps must implement three mandatory compliance webhooks — customers/data_request, customers/redact and shop/redact — so merchants and their customers can view or delete data. Your app’s privacy policy should describe the merchant and customer data you store and explain that you respond to these requests.

storeRule.title: Privacy law compliance — Mandatory compliance webhooks
storeRule.quote: The app must implement the mandatory compliance webhooks.

additionalRules.title: Subscribe before publishing
additionalRules.text: “You must subscribe to compliance webhooks before publishing your app.”

additionalRules.title: Why: GDPR and CPRA
additionalRules.text: Shopify explains that privacy rules such as the GDPR and CPRA set requirements for how apps handle personal data, which these webhooks support.

sdks.name: Compliance webhook topics
dataCollected: customers/data_request: requests to view stored customer data
customers/redact: requests to delete customer data
shop/redact: requests to delete shop data

whereToPaste: Shopify Partner Dashboard → your app’s listing → privacy policy URL.
Your app’s website and in-app settings page.

sampleClause.heading: Merchant and customer data
sampleClause.text: When a store installs our app, we store the shop’s domain, the owner’s email, and order details needed to print labels. We delete customer data within 30 days of a customers/redact request and all shop data within 48 hours of uninstall via shop/redact.

faqs.q: Do Shopify apps need their own privacy policy?
faqs.a: Yes, your app processes merchant and buyer data separately from the store, so publish a policy for the app itself and link it in your listing.

faqs.q: What are Shopify’s mandatory compliance webhooks?
faqs.a: customers/data_request, customers/redact and shop/redact. Apps must implement and subscribe to them before publishing.
